concepts.title: 基本恒等式与符号
concepts.summary: 使用倒数、商、勾股和奇偶恒等式，并用象限确定平方根的符号。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先保留原式定义域，再用 $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$、$1+\tan^2x=\sec^2x$、$1+\cot^2x=\csc^2x$。

method.title: 倒数、商与奇偶
method.body: 倒数：$\csc x=1/\sin x,\sec x=1/\cos x$；商：$\tan x=\sin x/\cos x,\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$。余弦与正割为偶函数，其余四个为奇函数。所有等式只在各边共同定义域上使用。

method.title: 倒数、商与奇偶
method.body: 倒数：$\csc x=1/\sin x,\sec x=1/\cos x$；商：$\tan x=\sin x/\cos x,\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$。余弦与正割为偶函数，其余四个为奇函数。所有等式只在各边共同定义域上使用。

en.title: Fundamental identities and signs
en.summary: Use reciprocal, quotient, Pythagorean and even–odd identities; use the quadrant to choose a square-root sign.

method.title: Reciprocals, quotients, and parity
method.body: Reciprocals: $\csc x=1/\sin x,\sec x=1/\cos x$; quotients: $\tan x=\sin x/\cos x,\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$. Cosine and secant are even; the other four functions are odd. Use every formula on the common domain of its two sides.

method.title: Reciprocals, quotients, and parity
method.body: Reciprocals: $\csc x=1/\sin x,\sec x=1/\cos x$; quotients: $\tan x=\sin x/\cos x,\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$. Cosine and secant are even; the other four functions are odd. Use every formula on the common domain of its two sides.

concepts.title: 三角式的代数化简
concepts.summary: 通分、因式分解及共轭化简与代数题相同。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 改写为正弦余弦，通分后使用勾股恒等式；约分后保留原限制。

en.title: Algebraic simplification
en.summary: Use common denominators, factoring and conjugates as in algebra.

method.title: Method
method.body: Rewrite with sines/cosines, combine fractions, and use Pythagorean identities; retain original restrictions after cancellation.

concepts.title: 反例与非恒等式
concepts.summary: 一个使两边均有定义却不相等的值就能否定恒等式。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 试 $0,\pi/2,\pi,3\pi/2$ 等；避开分母为零的值。

en.title: Counterexamples
en.summary: One input where both sides exist but differ disproves an identity.

concepts.title: 验证恒等式
concepts.summary: 在两边共同定义域内，把一边化为另一边或分别化为同一式。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 每步使用已知恒等式或合法代数变形；也可独立化简 $L-R$ 为零。

en.title: Verify identities
en.summary: On the common domain, transform one side into the other or both into a common expression.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use established identities or valid algebra at every step; alternatively simplify the independently formed residual $L-R$ to zero.

concepts.title: 三角代换与根式
concepts.summary: 代入后用勾股恒等式化简；角度区间决定绝对值。

en.title: Trigonometric substitution
en.summary: Substitute and apply a Pythagorean identity; the angle interval determines absolute values.

method.title: Method
method.body: Write $\sqrt{f^2}=|f|$, then use $0<\theta<\pi/2$ to choose the positive sign.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 由给定区间，角位于第 3 象限，正弦与余弦的符号分别为 -1、-1。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 使用勾股恒等式并按象限选符号：$\cos\theta=- \frac{5}{13},\quad\sin\theta=-\sqrt{1-(- \frac{5}{13})^2}=- \frac{12}{13}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所求为 $\tan\theta=\frac{12}{5}$。

en.prompt: If $\cos\theta=-5/13$ and $\pi<\theta<3\pi/2$, find $\tan\theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The given interval places the angle in Quadrant 3; the signs of sine and cosine are -1 and -1.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use a Pythagorean identity and the quadrant signs: $\cos\theta=- \frac{5}{13},\quad\sin\theta=-\sqrt{1-(- \frac{5}{13})^2}=- \frac{12}{13}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The requested value is $\tan\theta=\frac{12}{5}$.

en.label: Example 1

questions.prompt: 把下式改写为正弦、余弦并化简：$\cot x+\tan x+\csc x\sec x$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 共同定义域：$\cos{\left(x \right)}\ne0,\quad \sin{\left(x \right)}\ne0$。在此范围内逐步变形。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 用商、倒数、和差及勾股恒等式展开：$L=\frac{\sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{1}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$，$R=\frac{2}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 通分计算两式之差：$L-R=\frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子按 $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$ 化简：$\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1=\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以 $L-R=0$，即 $L=R$；约分没有恢复任何原来排除的点。

questions.answer: $\frac{2}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$

en.prompt: Rewrite in terms of sines and cosines and simplify: $\cot x+\tan x+\csc x\sec x$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Common domain: $\cos{\left(x \right)}\ne0,\quad \sin{\left(x \right)}\ne0$. Work throughout this domain.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Expand using quotient, reciprocal, sum/difference, and Pythagorean identities: $L=\frac{\sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{1}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$, $R=\frac{2}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Combine the fractions in the difference: $L-R=\frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Reduce the numerator using $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$: $\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1=\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $L-R=0$, so $L=R$; cancellation does not restore any point excluded from the original domain.

en.answer: $\frac{2}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$
en.label: Example 2

steps.title: 计算与推导

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 共同定义域：$\cot{\left(x \right)}\ne0,\quad \sin{\left(x \right)}\ne0$。在此范围内逐步变形。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 用商、倒数、和差及勾股恒等式展开：$L=\frac{\left(-1 + \frac{1}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)}}\right) \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)}}$，$R=\frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 通分计算两式之差：$L-R=- \frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1}{\sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子按 $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$ 化简：$- \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1=- \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以 $L-R=0$，即 $L=R$；约分没有恢复任何原来排除的点。

questions.answer: 在共同定义域上恒等式成立。

steps.title: Calculate and reason

questions.prompt: 验证恒等式 $\frac1{1-\sin x}-\frac1{1+\sin x}=\frac{\tan^2x+\sec^2x+1}{\csc x}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
计算与推导
steps.body: 用商、倒数、和差及勾股恒等式展开：$L=- \frac{1}{\sin{\left(x \right)} + 1} + \frac{1}{1 - \sin{\left(x \right)}}$，$R=\left(\frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}} + 1 + \frac{1}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}\right) \sin{\left(x \right)}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 通分计算两式之差：$L-R=- \frac{\left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\left(\sin{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \left(\sin{\left(x \right)} + 1\right) \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子按 $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$ 化简：$- \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \sin{\left(x \right)}=\left(- \sin^{3}{\left(x \right)} - \sin{\left(x \right)}\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right)=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以 $L-R=0$，即 $L=R$；约分没有恢复任何原来排除的点。

questions.answer: 在共同定义域上恒等式成立。

steps.body: Expand using quotient, reciprocal, sum/difference, and Pythagorean identities: $L=- \frac{1}{\sin{\left(x \right)} + 1} + \frac{1}{1 - \sin{\left(x \right)}}$, $R=\left(\frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}} + 1 + \frac{1}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}\right) \sin{\left(x \right)}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $L-R=0$, so $L=R$; cancellation does not restore any point excluded from the original domain.

questions.prompt: 作代换并化简 $\sqrt{1-x^2},\ x=\cos\theta$，假设 $0<\theta<\pi/2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入并用勾股恒等式：$\sqrt{1-\cos^2\theta}=\sqrt{\sin^2\theta}=|\sin\theta|=\sin\theta$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 给定区间使最后的正弦或余弦非负，所以可去绝对值。

questions.answer: $\sin\theta$

en.prompt: Substitute and simplify $\sqrt{1-x^2},\ x=\cos\theta$, assuming $0<\theta<\pi/2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute and use a Pythagorean identity: $\sqrt{1-\cos^2\theta}=\sqrt{\sin^2\theta}=|\sin\theta|=\sin\theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: On the given interval the final sine or cosine is nonnegative, so the absolute value can be removed.

en.answer: $\sin\theta$
en.label: Example 9

exercises.prompt: 用基本恒等式和代数运算化简 $(1+\tan x)(1-\tan x)+\sec^2x$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 共同定义域：$\cos{\left(x \right)}\ne0$。在此范围内逐步变形。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 用商、倒数、和差及勾股恒等式展开：$L=\left(- \frac{\sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)}} + 1\right) \left(\frac{\sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)}} + 1\right) + \frac{1}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$，$R=2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 通分计算两式之差：$L-R=- \frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子按 $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$ 化简：$- \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1=- \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以 $L-R=0$，即 $L=R$；约分没有恢复任何原来排除的点。

steps.body: 本题原式要求 $\cos x\ne0$。以上约分与变形只在这些条件下有效，不补入约分前无定义的点。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Combine the fractions in the difference: $L-R=- \frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Reduce the numerator using $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$: $- \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1=- \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} - \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $L-R=0$, so $L=R$; cancellation does not restore any point excluded from the original domain.

steps.body: 共同定义域：$\cos{\left(x \right)}\ne0,\quad \sin{\left(x \right)}\ne0$。在此范围内逐步变形。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 用商、倒数、和差及勾股恒等式展开：$L=\frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$，$R=-2 + \frac{1}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 通分计算两式之差：$L-R=\frac{\left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子按 $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$ 化简：$\left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)=\left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以 $L-R=0$，即 $L=R$；约分没有恢复任何原来排除的点。

steps.title: 原式的共同定义域
steps.body: 本题原式要求 $\sin x\cos x\ne0$。以上约分与变形只在这些条件下有效，不补入约分前无定义的点。

exercises.answer: 在共同定义域上恒等式成立。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Common domain: $\cos{\left(x \right)}\ne0,\quad \sin{\left(x \right)}\ne0$. Work throughout this domain.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Expand using quotient, reciprocal, sum/difference, and Pythagorean identities: $L=\frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{\cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$, $R=-2 + \frac{1}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Combine the fractions in the difference: $L-R=\frac{\left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)}{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Reduce the numerator using $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$: $\left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)=\left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1\right) \left(\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $L-R=0$, so $L=R$; cancellation does not restore any point excluded from the original domain.

steps.title: Common domain of the original expression
steps.body: The original expressions require $\sin x\cos x\ne0$. The cancellations and transformations are valid only under these conditions; do not restore points excluded before cancellation.

en.answer: The identity holds on the common domain.

steps.body: Expand using quotient, reciprocal, sum/difference, and Pythagorean identities: $L=\frac{-1 + \frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{1}{\sin{\left(x \right)}}}{1 + \frac{\cos{\left(x \right)}}{\sin{\left(x \right)}} + \frac{1}{\sin{\left(x \right)}}}$, $R=\frac{1 - \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Combine the fractions in the difference: $L-R=\frac{\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1}{\left(\sin{\left(x \right)} + \cos{\left(x \right)} + 1\right) \cos{\left(x \right)}}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Reduce the numerator using $\sin^2 w+\cos^2 w=1$: $\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1=\sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)} - 1=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $L-R=0$, so $L=R$; cancellation does not restore any point excluded from the original domain.

steps.body: The original expressions require $\sin x\cos x\ne0,\ \cos x+1+\sin x\ne0$. The cancellations and transformations are valid only under these conditions; do not restore points excluded before cancellation.

steps.body: Apply the Pythagorean identity twice to obtain $r^2\cos^2u+r^2\sin^2u=r^2$, valid for all real parameters.

exercises.prompt: 若 $\tan x+\cot x=2$，证明 (a) $\tan^2x+\cot^2x=2$；(b) $\tan^3x+\cot^3x=2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 共同定义域上 $\tan x\cot x=1$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 平方：$\tan^2x+2+\cot^2x=4$，故平方和为 $2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 立方和 $=(\tan x+\cot x)^3-3\tan x\cot x(\tan x+\cot x)=8-6=2$。

en.prompt: If $\tan x+\cot x=2$, show (a) $\tan^2x+\cot^2x=2$; (b) $\tan^3x+\cot^3x=2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: On the common domain $\tan x\cot x=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Square: $\tan^2x+2+\cot^2x=4$, so the sum of squares is $2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The sum of cubes is $(\tan x+\cot x)^3-3\tan x\cot x(\tan x+\cot x)=8-6=2$.

exercises.prompt: 若 $\sec x+\cos x=2$，证明 (a) $\sec^2x+\cos^2x=\sec^4x+\cos^4x=2$；(b) $\sec^3x+\cos^3x=2$。
exercises.answer: (a)、(b) 均成立。

en.prompt: If $\sec x+\cos x=2$, show (a) $\sec^2x+\cos^2x=\sec^4x+\cos^4x=2$; (b) $\sec^3x+\cos^3x=2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\cos x\ne0$. Put $c=\cos x$; $c+1/c=2$ gives $(c-1)^2=0$. Thus $c=1$ and $\sec x=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) The sum of squares is $1+1=2$ and the sum of fourth powers is $1+1=2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The sum of cubes is $1+1=2$.

en.answer: Both (a) and (b) follow.

exercises.prompt: 若 $\sin x+\sin^2x=1$，证明 $\cos^2x+\cos^4x=1$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 给定式说明 $\sin x=1-\sin^2x=\cos^2x$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 平方得到 $\sin^2x=\cos^4x$。所以 $\cos^2x+\cos^4x=\cos^2x+\sin^2x=1$。

en.prompt: If $\sin x+\sin^2x=1$, show $\cos^2x+\cos^4x=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The hypothesis gives $\sin x=1-\sin^2x=\cos^2x$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Squaring yields $\sin^2x=\cos^4x$. Therefore $\cos^2x+\cos^4x=\cos^2x+\sin^2x=1$.

exercises.prompt: $x=-x$ 不是恒等式，但两边平方后是恒等式。考虑 $\sqrt{\sin^2x}=\sin x$。(a) 给反例；(b) 证明两边平方后为恒等式。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 取 $x=3\pi/2$。左侧 $1$，右侧 $-1$，故不是恒等式。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 平方得 $\sin^2x=\sin^2x$，处处成立。平方会丢失符号信息；原左侧为 $|\sin x|$。

exercises.answer: (a) $3\pi/2$；(b) 平方后恒成立。

en.prompt: The nonidentity $x=-x$ becomes an identity after squaring. Consider $\sqrt{\sin^2x}=\sin x$. (a) Give a counterexample; (b) show squaring produces an identity.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) At $x=3\pi/2$, the left side is $1$ and the right side is $-1$, so it is not an identity.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Squaring gives $\sin^2x=\sin^2x$, true everywhere. Squaring loses sign information; the original left side is $|\sin x|$.

en.answer: (a) $3\pi/2$; (b) the squared equation is an identity.

exercises.prompt: 若 $x,y$ 为实数，解释为何 $\sec\theta$ 不可能等于 $xy/(x^2+y^2)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 若 $x=y=0$，右侧无定义。否则由 $(|x|-|y|)^2\ge0$ 得 $2|xy|\le x^2+y^2$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 因此 $|xy/(x^2+y^2)|\le1/2$；但任何有定义的实数正割都满足 $|\sec\theta|\ge1$。两范围不交。

exercises.answer: 不可能。

en.prompt: If $x,y$ are real, explain why $\sec\theta$ cannot equal $xy/(x^2+y^2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: If $x=y=0$, the right side is undefined. Otherwise $(|x|-|y|)^2\ge0$ gives $2|xy|\le x^2+y^2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $|xy/(x^2+y^2)|\le1/2$, whereas every defined real secant has magnitude at least $1$. The ranges are disjoint.

en.answer: Impossible.

exercises.prompt: 求使 $\sin\theta=(1+t^2)/(1-t^2)$ 可能成立的 $t$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 相减得 $4q\le0$，故 $q=0$，即唯一实数可能是 $t=0$。此时右侧为 $1$，取 $\theta=\pi/2$ 即可。

en.prompt: Find a value of $t$ for which $\sin\theta=(1+t^2)/(1-t^2)$ is possible.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $t=\pm1$ makes the denominator zero. Set $q=t^2\ge0$; the sine range requires $(1+q)^2\le(1-q)^2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Subtraction gives $4q\le0$, so $q=0$: the only real possibility is $t=0$. The right side is then $1$, realized by $\theta=\pi/2$.

exercises.prompt: 求使 $\cos^2\theta=\frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}$ 可能成立的 $a,b$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 目标范围分别是 $0\le\cos^2\theta\le1$ 或 $\csc^2\theta\ge1$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 由 $a^2+b^2\ge2|ab|$，可行时必须 $ab>0$，且等号成立，即 $(a-b)^2=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以恰好 $a=b\ne0$ 可行；例如 $a=b=1$。比值为 $1$，分别取 $\theta=0$ 或 $\theta=\pi/2$。

exercises.answer: $a=b\ne0$，例如 $a=b=1$。

en.prompt: Find values of $a,b$ for which $\cos^2\theta=\frac{a^2+b^2}{2ab}$ is possible.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The relevant ranges are $0\le\cos^2\theta\le1$ and $\csc^2\theta\ge1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The inequality $a^2+b^2\ge2|ab|$ forces $ab>0$ and equality in the feasible case, hence $(a-b)^2=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Exactly $a=b\ne0$ works, for example $a=b=1$. The ratio is $1$, realized by $\theta=0$ or $\theta=\pi/2$, respectively.

en.answer: $a=b\ne0$, for example $a=b=1$.

exercises.prompt: 求使 $\csc^2\theta=\frac{2ab}{a^2+b^2}$ 可能成立的 $a,b$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 目标范围分别是 $0\le\cos^2\theta\le1$ 或 $\csc^2\theta\ge1$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 由 $a^2+b^2\ge2|ab|$，可行时必须 $ab>0$，且等号成立，即 $(a-b)^2=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以恰好 $a=b\ne0$ 可行；例如 $a=b=1$。比值为 $1$，分别取 $\theta=0$ 或 $\theta=\pi/2$。

exercises.answer: $a=b\ne0$，例如 $a=b=1$。

en.prompt: Find values of $a,b$ for which $\csc^2\theta=\frac{2ab}{a^2+b^2}$ is possible.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The relevant ranges are $0\le\cos^2\theta\le1$ and $\csc^2\theta\ge1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The inequality $a^2+b^2\ge2|ab|$ forces $ab>0$ and equality in the feasible case, hence $(a-b)^2=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Exactly $a=b\ne0$ works, for example $a=b=1$. The ratio is $1$, realized by $\theta=0$ or $\theta=\pi/2$, respectively.

en.answer: $a=b\ne0$, for example $a=b=1$.

exercises.prompt: 证明当 $0<\theta<\pi/2$：(a) $\sin^2\theta+\csc^2\theta\ge2$；(b) $\cos^2\theta+\sec^2\theta\ge2$；(c) $\sec^2\theta+\csc^2\theta\ge4$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) $(\sin\theta-\csc\theta)^2\ge0$ 展开为所需不等式；等号要求 $\sin^2\theta=1$，在开区间内不发生。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) $(\cos\theta-\sec\theta)^2\ge0$ 同样给结论；开区间内也是严格大于。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (c) $\sec^2\theta+\csc^2\theta=1/(\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta)$。由 $(\sin^2\theta-\cos^2\theta)^2\ge0$ 得 $\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta\le1/4$，故倒数至少 $4$。等号在 $\theta=\pi/4$。

exercises.answer: 三式均成立；(c) 的等号在 $\pi/4$。

en.prompt: Prove for $0<\theta<\pi/2$: (a) $\sin^2\theta+\csc^2\theta\ge2$; (b) $\cos^2\theta+\sec^2\theta\ge2$; (c) $\sec^2\theta+\csc^2\theta\ge4$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Expand $(\sin\theta-\csc\theta)^2\ge0$. Equality requires $\sin^2\theta=1$, absent in the open interval.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Expanding $(\cos\theta-\sec\theta)^2\ge0$ proves the result; this inequality too is strict in the open interval.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (c) $\sec^2\theta+\csc^2\theta=1/(\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta)$. From $(\sin^2\theta-\cos^2\theta)^2\ge0$ we get $\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta\le1/4$, so its reciprocal is at least $4$. Equality occurs at $\theta=\pi/4$.

en.answer: All three hold; equality in (c) occurs at $\pi/4$.
